schema: gen20.1 S3 counts; label-free except the declared frozen quarantine mask (label_reads); deterministic, no timestamps

label_reads.what: gen13sep.cohort.apply_quarantine sentinel mask log_D <= LOG_D_FLOOR on the raw bundle (the frozen gen13 cohort-membership rule)
label_reads.rows_in_521_cells_definition: quarantined rows (either rule) inside the multi-metal cells of the unquarantined chain, which are the 521 bench cells; the sentinel rows are a subset
label_reads.used_for: cohort-chain membership counts only (C11-*); the column is dropped right after the mask; no statistic of it is computed

coh_reppair.verdict: log SF noise NOT ESTIMABLE from run-paired replicated adjacent pairs (fewer than 20 pairs from 5 chemotypes per BP training fold under every available run key); S5 reports 'not estimable' plus the labelled sqrt(2)*sigma bound (O16 default)

COH-D-ALL@NODMD.definition: every entry of the 521 cells minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-D-C3.definition: every measured entry of the C3 cells

COH-D-C3@NODMD.definition: every measured entry of the C3 cells minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-D-C3M.definition: C3 entries whose metal is in >= 1 Q_adj pair of its cell

COH-D-C3M@NODMD.definition: C3 entries whose metal is in >= 1 Q_adj pair of its cell minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-NOSC009-D@NODMD.definition: COH-D-C3 minus sc009 minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-NOSC009-SF@NODMD.definition: COH-SF-C3 minus sc009 minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-SC009-D@NODMD.definition: COH-D-C3 restricted to sc009 minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-SC009-SF@NODMD.definition: COH-SF-C3 restricted to sc009 minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-SF-ANY.definition: strict pairs of cells with >= 1 such pair

COH-SF-ANY@NODMD.definition: strict pairs of cells with >= 1 such pair minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-SF-C1.definition: strict pairs of cells with k_max >= 1

COH-SF-C1@NODMD.definition: strict pairs of cells with k_max >= 1 minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-SF-C3.definition: Q_adj pairs of the C3 cells

COH-SF-C3@NODMD.definition: Q_adj pairs of the C3 cells minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-SF-NDSM.definition: gen13-adjacency pairs (strict + Nd-Sm) of cells with a non-empty 'adjacent_gen13' query and metal-model k_max >= 3 under it

COH-SF-NDSM@NODMD.definition: gen13-adjacency pairs (strict + Nd-Sm) of cells with a non-empty 'adjacent_gen13' query and metal-model k_max >= 3 under it minus the DMDPhPDA cells

COH-TRAIN.definition: every measured entry of the masked outer-training cells per (design, split_seed, fold); nrep = replicate count; COH-NODMD training rows = rows with is_dmd False

COH-REP.definition: COH-TRAIN rows with nrep >= 2 (replicated entries of the outer-training cells; counts only, never values)

COH-INNER.definition: 4-fold chemotype inner cross-fit of every outer training fold: seeded_group_kfold(chemotype[train], 4, inner_seed(seed, fold)), gen20k.cov.inner_mask applied (role masked_out), skipped if < 20 masked inner-train cells; skipped_nodmd after removing the 5 DMDPhPDA cells (rows with is_dmd True)

COH-FROZEN.definition: the 521 cells of the frozen gen13 exact cohort (universe for folds and training); its entries are COH-D-ALL

COH-AUG.definition: single-metal gen13-key cells (canonical SMILES @@ publication_id @@ 64-column condition key) after the quarantine; NOT RUN (O23)

COH-REPPAIR.definition: strict-adjacent pairs whose two endpoints are replicated (nrep >= 2), with the number of run values (key column) in which a and b each have exactly one reading; run_paired = >= 2 such runs; identity columns only (O16 feasibility)
